personal_values.note: activity-adapted; UI categories are not validated scale dimensions

notes: STJ interaction is click-to-eliminate: the clicked/arrow-selected card is removed; the other card is the preferred item and stays when scheduling permits.
STJ inference uses balanced graph coverage, uncertainty-focused adaptive pairing, and regularized Bradley-Terry estimates rather than survivor counts.
Student report presents Top 3 current traits, Top 3 ideal traits, 3 retained traits, 3 growth directions, and Top 3 values.
Report interpretation uses selected Big Five facet-source structure, actual-ideal discrepancy, future-self distance/overlap, and values; it is not a normative Big Five score or diagnosis.
